title: Content Based Video Narration of Gameplay with Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.14016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Live game commentary is scarce: it exists for professional esports broadcasts and almost nowhere else. We present a content-based video narration system that produces spoken, esports-style commentary for arbitrary gameplay recordings using a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) and a text-to-speech back end, with no game-specific instrumentation, no engine telemetry, and no task-specific training. Three mechanisms carry the system. Temporal mosaic packing arranges nine uniformly sampled frames into a single 3x3 image, letting an image-native VLM reason about motion while consuming one image payload per segment instead of nine. Context-conditioned prompting replays the K most recent narrations as assistant-role history, suppressing the repetition that dominates per-segment captioning of static scenes. translated_title: 基于视觉语言模型的游戏内容视频解说
translated_abstract: 直播游戏解说十分稀缺：它仅存在于专业电子竞技转播中，几乎在其他地方看不到。我们提出了一种基于内容的视频叙述系统，该系统使用通用视觉语言模型（VLM）和文本转语音后端，为任意游戏录制生成口语化的电竞风格解说，无需特定游戏仪器、无需引擎遥测数据、也无需任务特定训练。该系统由三种机制支撑。时间马赛克打包将九个均匀采样的帧排列成单个3x3图像，使图像原生VLM能够在消耗每个片段一个图像载荷（而非九个）的情况下推理运动。上下文条件提示将最近K次解说作为助手角色历史回放，抑制了静态场景逐片段字幕中占主导的重复现象。时长条件生成和弹性对齐在提示中约束解说长度，然后进行时间缩放或对称填充。
tldr: 该系统通过时间马赛克打包、上下文提示和时长控制，实现了无需游戏特定数据的通用电竞风格视频解说。
en_tdlr: This system achieves game-agnostic esports-style video narration through temporal mosaic packing, context-conditioned prompting, and duration-conditioned generation.
